persona.name: Siti Aisyah
persona.summary: Siti is Operations Director at Johor Teknologi, a 70-person e-commerce logistics company. Company knowledge lives in WhatsApp, email, Google Workspace, and a custom WMS — predominantly Malay with English technical threads.
persona.situation: A billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres is planned next sprint, led by Siti. The Johor warehouse reports an inventory discrepancy on SKU-4820, and the team needs to decide whether a read replica is needed before the Postgres cutover.

scopes.label: db-migration
scopes.business_meaning: The billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres: planning, risk, and cutover timeline.

scopes.label: inventory-discrepancy
scopes.business_meaning: Johor warehouse inventory discrepancy on SKU-4820: short by 100 units, investigating scan error.

scopes.label: vendor-management
scopes.business_meaning: Vendor management: supplier contracts, SLA monitoring, and procurement processes.

messages.body: Keputusan: pindahkan pangkalan data pengebilan dari MySQL ke Postgres pada sprint berikutnya; penanggungjawab Siti, risiko gangguan perkhidmatan semasa peralihan.
Siti mengesahkan rancangan peralihan Postgres: Langkah 1 eksport data MySQL, Langkah 2 laksanakan cutover dalam tetingkap penyelenggaraan, Langkah 3 sahkan integriti data. Downtime dijangka 2 jam.
Engineering note (English): 'The MySQL to Postgres migration is ready for staging. Siti wants a dry run before production cutover. The maintenance window is Saturday 2-4 AM MYT.'
Gudang Johor melaporkan perbezaan stok: SKU-4820 kurang 100 unit berbanding sistem; sedang menyiasat ralat imbasan. Ketua gudang Encik Razak telah mengesahkan kiraan fizikal.
Punca: pengimbas kod bar lama mungkin terlepas beberapa imbasan. Pasukan IT telah mengemas kini firmware pengimbas dan mengira semula SKU-4820.
Kontrak pembekal: Pembekal database baru AWS telah disahkan untuk hosting Postgres. SLA 99.9% uptime. Siti sebagai penanggungjawab kontrak.

recall_tests.intent: Find the database migration plan and owner.

synthesis.business_question: What is the database migration plan, who owns it, and what is the risk?

forget.rationale: The inventory discrepancy has been resolved after firmware update and recount; the records can be purged.
